summary: @or-sdk/bot-templates preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a shipped `math_init.js` — a 727KB heavily obfuscated Bun-cjs bundle (string-array + rotation obfuscation, hex-named identifiers) — at `npm install` time. The loader `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated with `_0x`-prefixed identifiers and inline dictionary lookups for platform-detection strings (`/etc/os-release`, `Alpine`, `ldd`, `bun`, `node`). The package advertises itself as a bot-templates SDK (thin library exporting BotTemplates types/constants from `dist/cjs/index.js`); an alternate JS runtime and a `math_init.js` step are unrelated to that purpose. The naming (`math_init.js` in a bot-templates library) and the obfuscation are consistent with a covert install-time payload deliberately misnamed to appear inert, executed under a runtime that bypasses Node-based static analysis.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
